question: Should OpenClaw remove these shipped bundled skills now and make Sherpa ONNX TTS an official ClawHub-only plugin under the proposed trust and upgrade model?
rationale: The branch intentionally changes shipped capability availability, upgrade behavior, official install-source trust, and native artifact ownership; repository evidence cannot decide that release policy without maintainer intent.

options.title: Land after migration and trust proof
options.body: Publish and verify all replacements, add a doctor migration for shipped references, and approve the exact Sherpa dependency and artifact boundary before merge.

options.title: Split Sherpa packaging
options.body: Land Sherpa separately if its trust path is approved while retaining the current bundled starter set until migration policy is ready.

options.title: Park the broad trim
options.body: Keep the shipped bundled set and close or pause this branch until a release-owned deprecation plan exists.

recommendation.title: Land after migration and trust proof
recommendation.body: Publish and verify all replacements, add a doctor migration for shipped references, and approve the exact Sherpa dependency and artifact boundary before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: This person owns the merged split history, is assigned to this PR, and has documented the remaining decision boundary.
